# Practice the design choices, not just the estimator

This section collects worksheet-style pages for hands-on design work. Use it when you want to move from abstract method guidance into benchmark examples, tradeoff decisions, and concrete diagnostics.

<div class="page-metadata">
  <span>Hands-on exercises</span>
  <span>Benchmark examples</span>
  <span>Design-first workflow</span>
</div>
:::

## Difference-in-Differences Labs {#difference-in-differences-labs .section-heading}

[Environment setup and verified outputs](difference-in-differences-reproducibility.qmd) · [Applications and data](../notes/did/difference-in-differences-applications.qmd)

<p class="section-intro">Move from a transparent 2×2 contrast to staggered-adoption diagnostics, explicit group-time effects, and sensitivity analysis.</p>

::: {.section-grid}
::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-lab">Introductory</span>

### [DiD Foundations With Kentucky Workers' Compensation](difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.qmd)

Calculate the four-cell contrast by hand, recover it with an interaction regression, interpret a log outcome, and audit the assumptions hidden by a two-period design.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-foundations-lab.ipynb"}

[Python companion](difference-in-differences-foundations-python-lab.qmd) · [Download Python notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-foundations-python-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-foundations-python-lab.ipynb"}
:::

::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-core">Intermediate</span>

### [Staggered Adoption and TWFE Diagnostics](difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.qmd)

Map castle-law adoption cohorts, reconstruct TWFE with the Goodman-Bacon decomposition, and compare conventional and Sun–Abraham event studies.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-lab.ipynb"}

[Python companion](difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-python-lab.qmd) · [Download Python notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-python-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-staggered-diagnostics-python-lab.ipynb"}
:::

::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-applied">Advanced</span>

### [Modern Multi-Period Difference-in-Differences](difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.qmd)

Estimate and aggregate group-time effects with `did`, compare control groups and Sun–Abraham, then optionally probe parallel-trends sensitivity with `HonestDiD`.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-lab.ipynb"}

[Python companion](difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-python-lab.qmd) · [Download Python notebook](notebooks/difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-python-lab.ipynb){download="difference-in-differences-modern-estimators-python-lab.ipynb"}
:::
:::

## Synthetic Control Labs {#scm-labs .section-heading}

<p class="section-intro">Start with the core report, then move from SCM mechanics to the canonical case and then to the first principled extension.</p>

<span class="page-badge badge-lab">Introductory</span>

### [Synthetic Control Mechanics Lab](synthetic-control-mechanics-lab.qmd)

Best first practical exercise for learning `dataprep()`, `synth()`, donor weights, and gap plots without substantive complexity.

:::

::: {.section-card}

## Interrupted Time Series Labs {#interrupted-time-series-labs .section-heading}

<p class="section-intro">Use a real seatbelt-law case for the foundations and design choices, then validate untreated forecasts in a compact known-truth exercise.</p>

::: {.section-grid}
::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-lab">Introductory</span>

### [ITS Foundations With Seatbelts](interrupted-time-series-mechanics-lab.qmd)

Build the monthly interruption, compare pre/post summaries with segmented regression, estimate horizon-specific percentage changes, and optionally model AR(1) errors.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/interrupted-time-series-mechanics-lab.ipynb){download="interrupted-time-series-mechanics-lab.ipynb"}
:::

::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-core">Intermediate</span>

### [Seatbelt Law Design and Robustness](interrupted-time-series-design-diagnostics-lab.qmd)

Compare targeted outcomes, audit imperfect controls, test exposure-adjusted specifications, and write a defensible attribution judgment.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/interrupted-time-series-design-diagnostics-lab.ipynb){download="interrupted-time-series-design-diagnostics-lab.ipynb"}
:::

::: {.section-card}
<span class="page-badge badge-core">Advanced applied</span>

### [Interrupted Time Series Counterfactual Validation](interrupted-time-series-counterfactual-validation-lab.qmd)

Compare three untreated forecasting models on identical held-out origins, preserve the nearest competitor, report 12-month gaps, and stop unsupported extension.

[Download R notebook](notebooks/interrupted-time-series-counterfactual-validation-lab.ipynb){download="interrupted-time-series-counterfactual-validation-lab.ipynb"}
:::
:::

<div class="principle-banner">
  <h2>Working rule</h2>
  <p>Define the design before estimating, document the tradeoffs introduced by the design, and state clearly what the resulting comparison can and cannot support.</p>
</div>

</div>
